newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui sees flat copper, zinc, lead output.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui sees flat copper, zinc, lead output.

text.p: Mitsui Mining and Smelting Co Ltd said on Thursday that it expects its output of zinc, copper and lead in the first half of the 1997/98 year to be basically unchanged compared with the same period a year earlier.
Mitsui's scheduled output for the first half of fiscal 1997/98 and actual output for the 1996/97 first half were as follows (in tonnes, except for gold and silver in kilograms):
Figures include metal refined on a tolling basis.
The company said the decline in silver output was mainly due to lower raw material imports. Figures for actual output for the second half of 1996/97 were not yet available.
